g.title: PSU
g.text: Set the brick to 24 V and check with a meter BEFORE connecting anything.

g.title: WAGO+
g.text: All 5 slots are the same point. Strip 11 mm, lift lever, insert, close.

g.title: WAGO-
g.text: All 5 slots are the same point.

g.title: PIBOT_PWR
g.text: Vmot-main powers the board, Vmot-driver powers the socket drivers.
Both need 24 V. Check the + / - marking beside each terminal.

g.title: DM542T_HV
g.text: Follow the labels printed on the driver, not this order.
